name: 記事末尾のトピック一覧
prompt:
Create a clean 954 x 217 px image of the article-end topic chips shown in the references. Use the first reference as the geometry authority: white background, two left-aligned rows of large rounded capsules, exactly three chips on row one and two on row two. Keep the rows and generous pill proportions close to the crop: pill height about 95 px, row one near y=3, row two near y=121, horizontal gaps around 23 px, first pill flush with the left edge. Use natural pill widths based on each label, with consistent horizontal padding. Use the second reference as the authority for localized labels and Lighthouse colors: pale mint fill close to #ECFDF5 and restrained dark teal Japanese sans-serif text, similar to Meiryo. Render only these exact labels in this order, with no extra text:
Row 1: 地域の暮らし | 学び | これからの教会
Row 2: 対話 | 日々の発見
Keep text centered vertically and horizontally in each capsule. Preserve the simple flat style; no outlines, shadows, gradients, icons, extra labels, photos, or other page content. Ensure all Japanese characters are accurate and fully visible.
reviewNotes: Japanese labels and mint palette are correct, but fitting the first 3:1 generated canvas directly to the 954x217 source crop makes the pills visibly too shallow. Kept this as needs-correction and generated a second candidate with source-proportioned pills.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.role: original screenshot crop defining chip positions, dimensions, rounding, and two-row geometry
native Japanese chip labels and Lighthouse color reference
